decisions.reason: As a niche submarine lighting option with only a web mention and still-unresolved demand, it remains cheap to keep while uncertainty is high.
The medical examination light has a dedicated page and no negative results, so we keep the option open to see if it gains market acceptance.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires serve a stable safety segment, and with its own page and no adverse signals, we retain the option.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product with clear demand, making abandonment unlikely.
